description:
Close every running application in one click from the system tray.

Captain Kill Switch is a free system-tray utility that closes every running application in one click - a clean close request first, then a firm stop within two seconds. An allowlist model protects Windows system and session processes. Tiny native app, auto-updates, 10 languages. Anonymous usage statistics only; see https://captainkillswitch.com/privacy.
- Windows: apps that hide to the tray on close (Discord, Slack, Steam,
  Spotify, browsers in background mode) are now asked to end their
  session instead of being force-terminated; close requests go only to
  real application windows.
- Launch at login is on by default for new installs and can be turned
  off from the tray menu. Existing installs are unchanged.
- New "Send Feedback..." item in the tray menu.
- The one-time "ways to help" note appears after three sweeps.
